data.name: Musnah
data.gender_notes: Musnah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'musnaah' which means calm, tranquil, and serene. This name is often given to babies born during peaceful and harmonious times. The name Musnah carries the meaning “Calm, serene” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Musnah usually hope their child will grow to embody calm, serene and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes inner peace and contentment in Islam.
data.etymology: Musnah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Calm, serene.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Musnah total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
